index_movement.behavior: Promotion and demotion copy/swap all 32 bytes, preserving the network-index value while the roster ordinal changes.

classifications.0x540b20: Pre-removal cleanup via 605950, before the separate actual-removal callback table.
classifications.0x540b30: Promotion into the roster prefix counted by +88; increments prefix count; initializes destination 0x70-byte state.
classifications.0x540b40: Demotion out of that prefix; swaps four parallel arrays and decrements prefix count.
classifications.0x540b60: Conditional disconnected=true named notification before bit0 is cleared.

limits: These remaining callbacks are lifecycle operations; no generic index-property deserializer is identified here.
Byte14 bit0 is described by observed set/clear and partition effects, not assigned a universal authority/local name.
Direct roster displacement inventory excludes alias-relative operands and is not a complete relocation inventory.
Shared 32-byte records carry more properties than index; all fields must remain associated with the same entity.
No live game, new capture, modification, installation, or multiplayer verification.
